sources.title: Kotdivuāra
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Latvia
sources.officialityEvidence: Latvia's live MFA traveller guidance, updated 27 June 2026, expressly covers Latvian citizens and directs them to Côte d’Ivoire's visa-conditions service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Latvijas pilsoņiem un nepilsoņiem ieceļošanai Kotdivuārā ir nepieciešama vīza.

sources.title: Côte d’Ivoire visa procedure: pre-enrolment and airport enrolment
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, State-approved Côte d’Ivoire visa application service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live service identifies SNEDAI as the only visa-application website officially recognised and approved by the State of Côte d’Ivoire and specifies issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa est imprimé et délivré immédiatement à l’aéroport d’Abidjan.

sources.title: Sudāna
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Latvia
sources.officialityEvidence: Latvia's live MFA traveller guidance, updated 11 October 2025, expressly directs Latvian citizens and non-citizens to obtain Sudan entry visas through Sudan's Embassy in Sweden.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Latvijas pilsoņiem un nepilsoņiem ieceļošanai Sudānā ir jānoformē vīza Sudānas vēstniecībā Zviedrijā.

policies.title: Latvian ordinary passports: Côte d’Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Latvian visitors need a Côte d’Ivoire visa; the State-approved flow pre-approves online but prints and issues it at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Complete pre-enrolment and carry the approved document before boarding; at Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment, where the visa is printed and issued.
This normalizes actual issuance timing only; work, residence, special passports, eligibility checks and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d’Ivoire visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit pre-enrolment through the State-approved service and obtain approval before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is issued.

policies.title: Latvian ordinary passports: Sudan consular visitor visa
policies.summary: Latvia's MFA directs Latvian visitors to obtain Sudan's entry visa through Sudan's Embassy in Sweden before travel.
conditions: Obtain the visa through Sudan's Embassy in Sweden before travel, as directed by Latvia's MFA.
This is limited to ordinary Latvian-passport short visits and excludes work, residence, special documents, operational restrictions and final admission.
